posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina begins shooting 'Merry Christmas' with Vijay Sethupathi in Mumbai, with the production set to wrap by September across Goa and Pune.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's upcoming Imtiaz Ali romance with Vedang Raina and Sharvari drops June 12, while his historic sold-out MSG nights continue to make headlines.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia made waves at Cannes 2026 and BAFTA, while her action-packed spy thriller 'Alpha' with Bobby Deol and Sharvari is set for July 10 release.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka presented at the 2026 Oscars and confirmed six months of filming remain on SS Rajamouli's epic 'Varanasi' with Mahesh Babu.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK missed most of IPL 2026 as KKR got eliminated, busy filming 'King' in South Africa — the mega-budget action thriller confirmed for Christmas 2026.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena won at ZEE Samvad Real Heroes 2026 and dropped hints about a K3G sequel, while a viral airport video showed her going completely unrecognized.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha has started filming the fantasy film 'Naagin' and signed a Rs 17 crore deal for a female-led thriller with Ekta Kapoor after Stree 2's blockbuster success.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is using a body double for action sequences in Atlee's 'Raka' and SRK's 'King' post-pregnancy, and has exited both Kalki 2 and Spirit citing burnout.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer faces a FWICE non-cooperation directive over his Don 3 exit with Rs 45 crore in damages demanded, but says his 'focus remains firmly on work.'

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya dazzled at her 24th Cannes appearance in a stunning blue Luminara gown with 1500+ crystals, urging young actors to embrace authenticity over trends.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika's 'Cocktail 2' song with Shahid Kapoor is generating buzz, while she's started filming Allu Arjun and Atlee's mega-budget AA22xA6 ahead of her wedding.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha makes a fierce comeback with 'Maa Inti Bangaram' — the trailer dropped May 25 showcasing her intense dual avatar, with the film releasing June 19.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's collaboration with Atlee on the VFX-heavy sci-fi 'AA22xA6' is officially announced with a record Rs 175 crore paycheck — his biggest yet.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's sports drama 'Peddi' hits theaters June 4 with $393K in North American pre-sales and 100M+ trailer views — positioned as a global blockbuster.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR paid a moving tribute to his grandfather NTR on his 103rd birth anniversary at Hyderabad's NTR Ghat, with War 2 and Dragon both in the pipeline.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi is busy promoting Ram Charan's 'Peddi' ahead of its June 4 release, following the proud moment of 'Homebound' being selected as India's Oscar 2026 entry.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya's 'Chand Mera Dil' crossed Rs 15 crore in 5 days despite a Bharatanatyam dance controversy — her father Chunky Panday stepped in to defend the fusion choreography.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara's fierce War 2 poster alongside Hrithik and Jr NTR has fans hyped for the August 14 IMAX release, while she opens up about motherhood and raising her daughter.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik's War 2 is India's most expensive spy thriller at Rs 400 crore — he's recovering from a leg injury ahead of his epic dance face-off with Jr NTR in June.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' with Pooja Hegde is set for June release, though the 'Chunnari Chunnari' recreation drew criticism from original singer Abhijeet.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya wrapped her All Hearts Tour with a grand Mumbai finale on May 24, and has a packed US tour ahead including Newark, Texas, and UK dates for 2026.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: Rahman is on a 40-day digital detox composing the 'Ramayana' soundtrack for Ranbir Kapoor's Diwali 2026 epic, while his 'Chikiri Chikiri' track for Peddi goes viral.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's final film 'Jana Nayagan' targets a June 25 release after CBFC delays and piracy controversies, with industry legends rallying against the leak.
